3.21.2 Drawing and Design Paper 2 (449/2)
DESIGN PROBLEM
A physically challenged person on wheelchair usually requires a special working table to perform

 1. It should be easily moved from one position to another.
 2. It should be adjustable to comfortable heights.
 3. The working top should be adjustable to any desired angle of inclination.
 4. The table should have an extended top that is collapsable.
 5. The table should have provision for placement of light stationery like pencils, pens,
 pins, erasers and rulers.
REQUIREMENTS
 (a) Make free-hand sketches of two possible solutions for your design. (6 marks)
